## Triage: graded p1 · `domain:engine` · `area:records` · `bug` · `pm:queue`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-22T14:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

This is the save-door half of #25168 (ADR-0015 §4.2): `saveMetaItem` is `packages/metadata*`, which is `domain:engine`'s. It is the same rule and the same route the maintainer was told of on #25168, a metadata-protocol narrowing handled in 18.x. It covers:
- the object and datasource save doors;
- the reverse direction (a datasource changed to `managed` under stored `external` objects);
- `composeStacks`' artifact pass.

Measure the two inferred readings first.
